# Tendem MCP

> Official plugin distribution for the hosted Tendem MCP server. Install Tendem in your AI client to delegate tasks to vetted human experts via the Model Context Protocol — submit work in natural language, get a transparent quote, approve, and receive verified results as files and reports.

This repository contains per-client plugin manifests, skills, rules, hooks, and two small marketplaces. It does **not** contain the MCP server implementation — the server is hosted at `https://mcp.tendem.ai/mcp`. Pair this repo with the [Tendem product page](https://tendem.ai) and the [MCP documentation](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) for the full picture.

## Getting started

- [README](https://github.com/Toloka/tendem-mcp/blob/main/README.md): What Tendem is, what it can do, and how to install a client.
- [Tendem app](https://agent.tendem.ai): Sign up, run tasks, and download results.
- [Overview article](https://toloka.ai/blog/connect-your-ai-agent-to-human-experts-via-mcp/): How connecting an AI agent to human experts via MCP works.

## Plugin manifests

Per-client install manifests. Each surfaces the same hosted MCP server (`https://mcp.tendem.ai/mcp`) shaped for a specific client.

- [Claude Code plugin manifest](https://github.com/Toloka/tendem-mcp/blob/main/plugins/tendem/.claude-plugin/plugin.json): For Claude Code (also serves Cursor and Copilot CLI via the manifests below).
- [OpenAI Codex plugin manifest](https://github.com/Toloka/tendem-mcp/blob/main/codex/tendem/.codex-plugin/plugin.json): For OpenAI Codex / ChatGPT.
- [Cursor plugin manifest](https://github.com/Toloka/tendem-mcp/blob/main/plugins/tendem/.cursor-plugin/plugin.json): For Cursor.
- [GitHub Copilot CLI plugin manifest](https://github.com/Toloka/tendem-mcp/blob/main/plugins/tendem/.github/plugin/plugin.json): For the Copilot CLI.
- [Gemini CLI extension manifest](https://github.com/Toloka/tendem-mcp/blob/main/gemini-extension.json): `gemini-extension.json` for `gemini extensions install` from the GitHub URL.
- [Kiro Power](https://github.com/Toloka/tendem-mcp/tree/main/tendem-power): Steering bundle + MCP config for Kiro.
- [MCP server config](https://github.com/Toloka/tendem-mcp/blob/main/plugins/tendem/.mcp.json): Generic `mcpServers` declaration with `"type": "http"`.
- [MCP Registry manifest](https://github.com/Toloka/tendem-mcp/blob/main/server.json): `server.json` for the official MCP Registry catalog.

## Marketplaces

Install straight from this repo:

- [Claude Code marketplace](https://github.com/Toloka/tendem-mcp/blob/main/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json): `/plugin marketplace add Toloka/tendem-mcp` then `/plugin install tendem@tendem-mcp`.
- [Codex marketplace](https://github.com/Toloka/tendem-mcp/blob/main/.agents/plugins/marketplace.json): `codex plugin marketplace add Toloka/tendem-mcp` then `codex plugin add tendem@tendem-mcp`.

## Skills and steering

Steering for AI assistants that drives the Tendem task lifecycle.

- [tendem-tasks (Claude/Cursor/Copilot)](https://github.com/Toloka/tendem-mcp/blob/main/plugins/tendem/skills/tendem-tasks/SKILL.md): End-to-end path — create, scope, approve, poll, fetch — with polling discipline and negotiation rules.
- [tendem-tasks (Codex/ChatGPT)](https://github.com/Toloka/tendem-mcp/blob/main/codex/tendem/skills/tendem-tasks/SKILL.md): Same lifecycle, with Codex-specific file-upload guidance.
- [tendem-lifecycle rule (Cursor)](https://github.com/Toloka/tendem-mcp/blob/main/plugins/tendem/rules/tendem-lifecycle.mdc): Always-apply lifecycle + safety rules.
- [tendem-watcher agent](https://github.com/Toloka/tendem-mcp/blob/main/plugins/tendem/agents/tendem-watcher.md): Background watcher that pings the user when a task needs them.
